Class ScenarioConfigPaneBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioConfigPaneBuilder
public final class ScenarioConfigPaneBuilder extends Object
Controller assembling the left scrollable configuration pane containing all 12 scenario parameter sections, header, validation banner, and pinned action bar.

      public static javafx.scene.layout.VBox assembleConfigPane(javafx.scene.control.Label headerLabel, javafx.scene.layout.VBox validationBanner, javafx.scene.layout.VBox presetSection, javafx.scene.layout.VBox inheritedSection, javafx.scene.layout.VBox spatiotemporalSection, javafx.scene.layout.VBox demographicSection, javafx.scene.layout.VBox culturalSection, javafx.scene.layout.VBox clippingSection, javafx.scene.layout.VBox oceanOptSection, javafx.scene.layout.VBox eventsSection, javafx.scene.layout.VBox snapshotSection, javafx.scene.layout.VBox bundleSection, javafx.scene.layout.VBox liveDiagnosticCard)
      Assembles all configuration sections into the master scrollable VBox root.
      Parameters:
      headerLabel - panel title header
      validationBanner - validation error banner
      presetSection - global presets section
      inheritedSection - inherited planet invalid input: '&' ecology section
      spatiotemporalSection - timeline invalid input: '&' resolution section
      demographicSection - population identity card section
      culturalSection - cultural vector invalid input: '&' layers section
      clippingSection - spatial clipping section
      oceanOptSection - engine architecture invalid input: '&' optimization section
      eventsSection - scheduled events section
      snapshotSection - snapshot resumption section
      bundleSection - unified scenario bundle section
      liveDiagnosticCard - live viability diagnostic card
      Returns:
      master configuration VBox
